Samsung’s Galaxy Buds On, a pair of clip-on earbuds that sit on the outside of the ear, will go on sale in the US in early November 2026 for $229, Samsung said on 28 October 2026. Each earbud weighs 6.65 g, plays music for up to 9.5 hours on a charge and answers a call when the wearer nods.

The earbuds will be sold in a single colour, Black, and Samsung has not given a firmer US date.
